limits: Head alpha centroid <=2px does not establish anatomical cranium/face center <=2px.
Same template body silhouettes and gait remain strongly similar across class. Color diversity improves recognition but does not eliminate copy-paste appearance.
Clothing hem lengths within female class are mostly similar; stated distinct lengths not independently achieved for every pair.
Historical audit checks supplied list, not exhaustive historical authentication. No obvious forbidden rich-scarlet/purple/black commoner whole-outfit observed.
